field.label: Custom TTL
field.help: TTL returned for answers coming from the entries on the Host Overrides tab.

field.label: Filter unmapped types
field.help: For a mapped name, return an empty answer for record types you have not provided (e.g. no AAAA when only an IPv4 address is mapped) instead of forwarding the query upstream.

field.label: Zone file
field.help: Optional DNS zone-file content for advanced records (e.g. CNAME), in standard zone format, e.g. printer.lan. IN A 192.168.1.20. Names end with a dot unless an $ORIGIN line comes before them, and every record needs a TTL, the class IN or a $TTL line before it. $INCLUDE is not accepted. Applied in addition to the simple entries on the Host Overrides tab.
